simplesect.para: Default range flat work group size for a calling convention.

Subtarget's default pair of minimum/maximum flat work group sizes for function F, or minimum/maximum flat work group sizes explicitly requested using "amdgpu-flat-work-group-size" attribute attached to function F.
Subtarget's default values if explicitly requested values cannot be converted to integer, or violate subtarget's specifications.

Subtarget's default pair of minimum/maximum number of waves per execution unit for function F, or minimum/maximum number of waves per execution unit explicitly requested using "amdgpu-waves-per-eu" attribute attached to function F.

Subtarget's default values if explicitly requested values cannot be converted to integer, violate subtarget's specifications, or are not compatible with minimum/maximum number of waves limited by flat work group size, register usage, and/or lds usage.

briefdescription.para: Return the amount of LDS that can be used that will not restrict the occupancy lower than WaveCount.

Subtarget's minimum/maximum occupancy, in number of waves per EU, that can be achieved when the only function running on a CU is F and each workgroup running the function requires LDSBytes bytes of LDS space.

detaileddescription.para: This notably depends on the range of allowed flat group sizes for the function and hardware characteristics.

briefdescription.para: Subtarget's minimum/maximum occupancy, in number of waves per EU, that can be achieved when the only function running on a CU is MF.

detaileddescription.para: This notably depends on the range of allowed flat group sizes for the function, the amount of per-workgroup LDS space required by the function, and hardware characteristics.

briefdescription.para: Return true if the subtarget supports True16 instructions.
Return true if real (non-fake) variants of True16 instructions using 16-bit registers should be code-generated.

detaileddescription.para: Fake True16 instructions are identical to non-fake ones except that they take 32-bit registers as operands and always use their low halves.

briefdescription.para: Return the maximum number of bytes of LDS available for all workgroups running on the same WGP or CU.

detaileddescription.para: For GFX10-GFX12 in WGP mode this is 128k even though each workgroup is limited to 64k.

briefdescription.para: Return the maximum number of bytes of LDS that can be allocated to a single workgroup.

detaileddescription.para: For GFX10-GFX12 in WGP mode this is limited to 64k even though the WGP has 128k in total.

briefdescription.para: Number of SIMDs/EUs (execution units) per "CU" ("compute unit"), where the "CU" is the unit onto which workgroups are mapped.

detaileddescription.para: This takes WGP mode vs. CU mode into account.
